candidate_axiom.name: Gödelian Incompleteness Demarcation & Meta-System Ascent
candidate_axiom.statement: When an architectural verification harness encounters an unprovable self-referential invariant within system state S, the compiler must ascend to meta-language M(S) rather than forcing unsound decidability.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Candidates attempting to assert complete self-verification within their own operational calculus are rejected.

metadata.exogenous_domain: Mathematical Logic & Metamathematics (Kurt Gödel & Alfred Tarski)
metadata.source_principle: Tarskian Truth Hierarchy and Undecidability Escalation

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Base System Calculus L0] ──> [Self-Reference Detector]
                                       │
                                       ▼
                         [Undecidability Demarcator]
                                       │
                                       ▼
                         [Meta-Language Escalator L1] ──> [Sound External Arbiter]

Self-Reference Detector.role: Identifies circular self-referential verification loops in component proofs.
Self-Reference Detector.invariant_rule: Flags statements that assert their own unprovability.

Undecidability Demarcator.role: Distinguishes between falsified assertions and formally undecidable invariants.
Undecidability Demarcator.invariant_rule: Halts infinite verification loops when undecidability is detected.

Meta-Language Escalator.role: Transfers evaluation authority to higher-order supervisor logic.
Meta-Language Escalator.invariant_rule: Preserves consistency of base calculus by isolating paradoxes.

target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Instantly terminates search loops stuck on undecidable invariant proofs (+0.0170).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces sound, paradox-free architectural compilation specifications (+0.0150).

tradeoffs.strengths: Provably prevents paradoxes and infinite compile-time verification loops.
tradeoffs.constraints: Requires multi-tiered execution environment with supervisor capabilities.

leaderboard.statement: The internal degrees of freedom in an architectural verifier must be greater than or equal to the disturbance variety in target environments (H(V) >= H(E)), ensuring regulatory capacity matches environmental entropy.

                                                    │

                                                    │

Entropy Match Gauge.role: Computes Shannon entropy of target failure states and environmental inputs.
Entropy Match Gauge.invariant_rule: Rejects verifiers with insufficient state space resolution.

Verifier Variety Expander.role: Dynamically scales internal observation channels to match target complexity.
Verifier Variety Expander.invariant_rule: Allocates observation dimensions proportionally to environmental noise.

Requisite State Regulator.role: Maintains system goal invariants despite high-dimensional disturbances.
Requisite State Regulator.invariant_rule: Ensures output variance remains within bounded goal tolerances.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Forces generators to invent high-capacity, expressive architectural governors (+0.0150).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Quickly discards overly simplistic controllers that cannot cover system states (+0.0130).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Guarantees robust operational envelopment for compiled systems (+0.0140).

tradeoffs.strengths: Ensures supervisory mechanisms are never blindsided by unforeseen environmental states.
tradeoffs.constraints: Increases memory overhead of regulatory and logging subsystems.

leaderboard.name: Category-Theoretic Adjunction & Galois Connection
leaderboard.statement: Specification syntax and compiled runtime semantics must form an adjoint functor pair F -| G such that compilation guarantees universal factorization and bidirectional semantic preservation.
leaderboard.operational_rule: Transformations lacking adjoint right-inverses or failing Galois round-trip closure are pruned.
leaderboard.domain: Category Theory & Abstract Algebra (Daniel Kan & Saunders Mac Lane)
leaderboard.principle: Adjoint Functor Duality and Universal Factorization

system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Specification Domain C] ──(Left Functor F)──> [Runtime Domain D]
               │                                       │
               ▲                                       ▼
        [Unit eta] <──(Right Functor G)── [Counit epsilon]

Left Adjoint Functor F.role: Synthesizes free structural implementations from abstract declarative specifications.
Left Adjoint Functor F.invariant_rule: Must preserve all colimits and coproducts from category C.

Right Adjoint Functor G.role: Extracts forgetful behavioral observations from concrete execution runtimes.
Right Adjoint Functor G.invariant_rule: Must preserve all limits and Cartesian products into category D.

Adjunction Unit Arbiter.role: Verifies that round-trip transformation satisfies triangular identities.
Adjunction Unit Arbiter.invariant_rule: Unit-counit composition must evaluate to identity morphism.

target_behaviors.target_e1_diversity: Connects categorical algebra with practical system compilers (+0.0140).
target_behaviors.target_e2_velocity: Enables algebraic verification of compilation correctness without simulation (+0.0160).
target_behaviors.target_e3_yield: Produces highly composable, mathematically sound structural architectures (+0.0160).

tradeoffs.strengths: Provable bidirectional correctness; specifications always match compiled binaries.
tradeoffs.constraints: Strict category-theoretic constraints limit ad-hoc optimizations.
